scope: Same six exploratory public clips; two directional fits, each trained only on its own three source clips and evaluated on the other embryo.
selection: One fixed residual-head recipe after observing the frozen-checkpoint pilot. No target-driven hyperparameter sweep; general_v1 was the primary checkpoint before this experiment.
features: 288 genuine HOCT edge embedding channels, mean over the same upstream overlapping windows; all candidate edges cached without labels.
base: Frozen upstream parent and orphan probabilities. Add a trainable linear residual to log parent probability, retain the orphan log probability, and renormalize.
standardization: Mean/std from supported source candidate rows only; std floor 0.001, clip standardized features to [-6,6].
targets: One known incoming parent per supported annotated target. Competing incoming parents are negatives. Unlabeled targets and missing-parent cases are excluded; no negative outgoing siblings or synthetic orphan labels.
decoder: Same frozen standalone HOCT decoder and separate no-division control. No baseline graphs, native scores or division protection.
freeze: Fit both source directions and freeze coefficients before adapted graph generation and target scoring.
exposure: Direct head fitting excludes the target embryo; upstream pretraining exposure remains unresolved, and these public clips have been repeatedly inspected.
